(277)༄༅/ /dpal karma pa chen po la brten pa'i thun bzhi'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dmigs khrid dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (277)༄༅// dpal karma pa chen po la brten pa'i thun bzhi'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dmigs khrid dang bcas pa bzhugs so/// /

(278)༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ de nas dus thams cad dang khyad par thun chen po bzhir bya ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ da ni kho bo mi bskyod rdo rje kho na min pa bsam rgyu med pa kun rang gi lus ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gcer bu lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ dbu skra sil mas rgyab non pa/ 'od phung gi dbus na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la thogs pa/ me tog dmar po'i rgyan can/ gzhan rgyan spangs pa/ de'i mdun du rje btsun mi bskyod rdo rje stag lpags kyi sham thabs glang chen pags pa'i bla gos can/ phyag rgya drug gis spras pa/ dbu skra thor tshugs sna tshogs rdo rje bla bas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'byung gi phyag rgya spyi bor bkod pa/ zhabs g.yon skyil krung phyed pa/ g.yas brkyangs pas ye shes kyi me phung gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ de la yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi stab pa tsam gyis ye shes kyi me dmar 'ur gyis 'bar ba/ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i bha ga nas spyan drangs/ thugs kar zhugs par mos la/ rlung drag sbyor gyi ngang nas gsol ba thob cig dang*/ kho bo mi bskyod rdo rjes byin gyis rlob pa yin no zhes byin dbab par bya'o// na mo gu ru/ spyi bo'i gtsug na ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// gcer bu bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas// skra grol (279)spyan gsum nam mkha'i mthong la gzigs// bde ba mi bzod 'gyur ba'i gar stabs ston// de 'dra grangs med gzhal med bun long nang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje ni// dge slong cha lugs zhwa nag gser mdongs can// thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// bde stong dbye ba med pa'i lta stangs mdzad// gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mos gus 'bar// mos gus 'bar ba tsam gyis byin rlabs 'ur// byin rlabs 'ur ba tsam gyis thun mong dang*// mchog gi dngos grub nor bu 'bar ba bsnams// gnam sa bla 'og med par char ltar 'bab// da ni snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus// kyai/

snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*// snang stong dbyer med bla ma'i sku// bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma'i sku yis byin gyis rlobs// grag cing stong la stong zhing grags// grag stong dbyer med bla ma'i gsung*// bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma'i gsung gis byin gyis rlobs// bde zhing stong la stong zhing bde// bde stong dbyer med bla ma'i thugs// bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma'i thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs// (280)kye// gu ru rat+na byon pa'i tshe// nam mkha' 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang*// sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed mdzad cing*// byin rlabs me dpung 'u ru ru// nyams dang rtog pa sha ra ra// kyai/ bla ma chen po khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir// byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol// dgra bgegs ma lus zhi bar mdzod// ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang gu mkha' la shar// nad gnon dri ma'i tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsal// sdig sgrib nyes pa rgyud du 'khris pa rnams// rnal 'byor ma dpal mdun du mthol lo bshags// ye shes mkha' 'gro ser mo mkha' la shar// nad gdon dri ma'i tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsal// sdig sgrib nyes pa rgyud du 'khris pa rnams// rnal 'byor ma dpal mdun du mthol lo bshags// ye shes mkha' 'gro dmar mo mkha' la shar// nad gdon dri ma'i tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsal// sdig sgrib nyes pa rgyud du 'khris pa rnams// rnal 'byor ma dpal mdun du= /ye shes mkha' 'gro dkar mo= /nad gdon dri ma'i tshogs rnams= /sdig sgrib nyes pa rgyud du= /rnal 'byor ma dpal= /ye shes mkha' 'gro nag mo= /nad gdon dri ma'i tshogs= /sdig sgrib nyes pa rgyud=

/rnal 'byor ma= /ye shes mkha' 'gro sngon mo= /nad gdon dri= /sdig sgrib nyes= /rnal 'byor ma= /ye shes mkha' 'gro khra mo= /nad gdon dri= /sdig sgrib nyes= /rnal 'byor ma dpal mdun du mthol lo bshags// nam mkha' gang ba'i mi bskyod rdo rje āḥ /'od zer 'gyed pa'i rdo rje dga' ba hoḥ /pho nya 'bar ba'i dbyangs can nus pa hūm̐// dri ma sel ba'i phrin las drag po oṃ// rje btsun dam pa sku bzhi'i (281)dbang phyug /ci mdzad ye shes kyi rol par 'char ba// khyab bdag rgyal dbang karma pa chen po// sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho mkhyen no// yon tan gyi phung po nyes pa kun zad// sangs rgyas kyi snying po bla mar snang ba// thugs rje'i dbang po mchog gi sprul sku// rje btsun rdo rje'i dbyangs can mkhyen no// nam gzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma'i res// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dwags po bka' brgyud// skal ldan gyi sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa// 'gran zla dang bral ba'i brgyud pa mkhyen no// tha mal gyi 'khrul pa rang gal zhig ste// chos dbyings dri med kyi rang gzugs gsal ba// phrin las kyi mnga' bdag dus gsum mkhyen pa// brtse ba chen po'i bdag nyid mkhyen no// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sna tshogs tshul gyis// sems can 'dul mdzad rgyal ba'i dbang po// re sa ltos sa dang bcas pa yin pas// dngos grub kyi 'byung khung dam pa mkhyen no// rje rgyal ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas// skal ldan smin par mdzad pa'i nus can// bde bar gshegs pa karma pa'i kaṃ tshang*// sgrib gnyis rnyogs pa dang bral ba mkhyen no// rje phrin las bzhi la rang dbang thob nas// ye shes gtad tsam gyis byin rlabs 'pho ba// sgrub brgyud gcig bsdus rdo rje'i dbyangs can// dpal ldan karma pa chen po mkhyen no// rdo rje 'chang chen yon tan brgyad ldan// he ru ka dpal ni yan lag bdun ldan// rgyal ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// rje rgyal dbang mi bskyod rdo rje mkhyen no// rgyal ba gcig bsdus karma pa mkhyen no// sangs rgyas gcig bsdus karma pa mkhyen no// bde gshegs gcig bsdus karma pa mkhyen no// thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa mkhyen no// karma pa mkhyen no//

zhes grangs med brjod/ thugs rje gcig bsdus mkhyen no// sangs rgyas gcig bsdus mkhyen no// kun 'dus chos rje mkhyen no// mi bskyod (282)rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// chos grags rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so// dwags po bka' brgyud la gsol ba 'debs so// karma kaṃ tshang la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun khyed rang lta bur shog cig /chos rje khyed rang lta bur shog cig /bla ma khyed rang lta bur shog cig /'gro mgon khyed rang lta bur shog cig /pha gcig thams cad mkhyen pa// sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob// rgyal dbang mi bskyod rdo rje// gsol ba nga yis mi 'debs na su yis 'debs// thugs rjes khyod kyis mi gzigs na su yis gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /spyir du sems can thams cad// sgos su snyigs ma'i gdul bya// lhag par re stos gcig chog tu bcas pa'i// blo gtad 'gyur ba med pa// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol cig /byin rlabs khyod la med na su la yod// byams pas bdag la mi skyong na su la skyong*// sku drin nga yis mi gzhal na su yis gzhal// gdul bya khyod kyis mi 'dul na su yis 'dul// las ngan nga rje la mi re na su la re// mthu stobs can khyod bdag mi skyobs na su la skyobs// bdag gi gtan 'dun skye ba kun gyi skyel ma// the tshom rtsad nas zad pa'i gtan nor// blo gtad lings bskyur thub pa'i mgon po// srid mtsho gtan skyems su gnas pa'i sangs rgyas// yon tan gzhal bar mi nus pa'i rgya mtsho// mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi ma gcig /thugs rje gtugs pa med pa'i gter chen/ snyigs dus 'gro ba mi dgongs su la dgongs/ brtse bas da lta mi skyong na nam skyong*/ dngos grub deng sang mi stsol na nam stsol/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres su thong la// 'khrul grol mdud pa shig dang*/

mkha' khyab smig rgyu'i 'gro ba/ da ltar gtan grol du mdzod cig /bla ma dam pa/ mtha' med sems can la gzigs dang*/ gsol ba 'debs (283)po la skyobs dang*/ mi bzad gdungs ba'i dus 'dir/ ci bya tshang brlag skabs na/ mya ngan 'jigs sngangs kyi dus su gzigs shing*// bla ma rin po che/ don gyi brgyud pa can/ byin rlabs kyi 'pho ba mkhan/ rtogs pa'i gding tshad can/ mngon shes spyan dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul bkod pa bstan te/ bzod med bka' drin stsol ba/ sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtod pa/ tha mal snang ba bsgyur te/ dag pa rab 'byams ston pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ gcig thub gsol ba 'debs so// thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu dang*/ dngos grub kyi tshan kha can/ bka' brgyud rtsod pa med pa/ dmu rgod 'dul bar nus pa'i/ phrin las 'gran zla bral ba/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam pa/ sgo gsum dge rtsa dang bcas pa/ mtha' med sems can don du/ da lta nyid du 'bul lo// brtse ba chen pos bzhes shing*// bzhes nas 'gro ba kun gyi/ gtan skyabs thub pa'i bla ma/ rje btsun khyed rang lta bur/ snying nas byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// ci mdzad legs par mthong bar byin gyis rlobs shig /ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin par byin= thugs yid gcig tu 'dre bar= skye ba nas skye ba tshe rabs tshe rabs thams cad du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dgyes pa'i bya ba dang mi 'bral bar byin gyis rlobs shig /mi dgyes pa'i bya ba rnam pa thams cad du mi 'byung bar= skye ba nas skye ba tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du blo gtad bla ma la bcas nas chos bzhin gyi bka' stsal gang gnang ba de lag thog tu len nus par= lto gos kyi ngo bsrung dang chos brgyad kyi 'brel thag chod par byin= snying la rus pa dum bu re yod par byin gyis rlobs shig /nges par 'chi ba snying nas dran pa dang*/

mos gus rnal ma rgyud (284)la skye ba nas// zhen log mtha' ru phyin pa'i nges 'byung gis// mi bskyod dga' ba'i byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /skye ba kun tu dpal ldan karma pa// mi bskyod rdo rje bla mar bsten byas nas// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi zung 'jug sku 'grub shog /skye ba kun tu yongs 'dzin dam pa mchog /zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa kho na dang*// yi dam snying po dpal ldan bde ba mchog /'khor lo sdom pas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /lam gyi snying po mos gus phyag rgya che// zhen log ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma'i sku// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang nyid// rnal 'byor 'dan ma grub thob sangs rgyas rje'i// go 'phang bde blag sems can thams cad kyis// 'grub phyir bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// dge tshogs 'bad pa de yi phyir du bsngo// dpal ldan sangs rgyas mnyan pa yab sras dang*// skye dang tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral shog /mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud la gsol ba 'debs so// mi mchog dus gsum mkhyen pa la gsol ba 'debs so// sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang la= /thugs rje can rang byung kun mkhyen la= /nus pa can sangs rgyas mnyan pa la= /byin rlabs can dga' ba'i dbyangs can la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun rdo rje dbyangs can la= /mtshungs med rdo rje dga' ba la= /zla med dbyangs can bzang po la= /'gran med mi bskyod bzang po la= /mkhyen rab mtshungs med la= /thugs rje mtshungs med la= /nus pa mtshungs med la= /'chi ba snying nas gzer bar byin gyis rlobs// zhen pa gting nas log par= /cis kyang dgos med rtogs par= /mi rtag nges shes skye bar byin= /nye ring med pa'i thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs so// phyogs lhung med pa'i phrin las can la= /snga phyi med pa'i byin rlabs can la= /mthong (285)thos don ldan gyi mdzad pa can la=

/rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho la= /kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje la gsol= /rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag= /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje la= /gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug= /rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje la= /dpal ldan ye shes snying po la= /mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje la= /dpal chen chos kyi don grub la= /rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje la= /si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas la= /rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje la= /mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la= /pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la= /theg pa mchog gi rdo rje la= /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /zhing khams sprul pas khyab pa la= /rab 'byams zhing gi bdag po la= /bsam brjod re ba las 'das pa la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes bya ba 'di ni 'brel pa thogs chog ma'i gsol 'debs su grags pa tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su chud pa'i rna lam du lan cig bsgrags kyang ngan song gi skye sgo du ma chod nas/ mthar nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams na rje btsun rdo rje'i dbyangs can de nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shin tu dkar ba'i 'od zer gyi phyag ring po brkyangs nas/ skad cig lag pa brkyang bskum tsam la 'dren par zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no// mi 'jigs pa'i dbugs chen po 'byin pa'i chos rje stobs po che la gsol ba 'debs so// skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la// skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing*// ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis// bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// (286)sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog

༈ /thun bzhi'i dmigs rim zin bris bzhugs so// na mo gu ru karma kā ye/ ngo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos yin zhing*// gu ru mtshan brgyad zhang gi sku brgyad dang*// karma rabs brgyad ngo bo gcig par bshad// de phyir zhang gi bka' 'bum bka' rgya las// btus shing cung zad bsnon kha btab nas kyang*// mi bskyod rdo rjes thun bzhi 'di nyid mdzad// 'di yi dmigs rim dbang phyug rdo rje la// yang ri drung po bsod nams bzang po yis// zhus nas mdzad pa'i rgyas pa yod mod kyang*// gzhung 'di'i dmigs rim kho na ma yin zhing*// phyag chen chos drug mos gus phyag chen gsum// don bsdus dmigs rim ha cang mang drag cing*// bar skabs 'don cha sab rgyu mang ba'i phyir// 'di nyid 'don pa'i srog ni ma byung ngo*// mgo 'di ma nam bzhi bskor 'don srol snang*// 'di yi gzhung tshig nyid kyi bsgom bya ni// rang nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi bo'i thad// mkha' 'gro dmar mo mdzes shing yid du 'ong*// dbu skra sil bu spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs// seng ldeng ḍā ru bhan+dha bdud rtsi bsnams// rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs 'od zer 'bar// zag med bde ba chen po rgyas pa'i phyir// gar stabs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs cir yang ston// dkar mo ser mo dmar mo ljang mo dang*// sngon mo nag mo khra mo'i sku mdog can// de 'dra grangs med bye ba dung phyur rnams// nam mkha' bar snang gang bar rdul bzhin 'tshubs// de dbus spyi gtsug thad nas kyi nam mkha' la// 'ja' gur 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i gur khang na// pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du// mi bskyod rdo rje chos dbyings rdo rje sogs// rang gi gang mos rgyal ba karma pa// chos gos ngur smrig zhwa nag gser mdangs can// (287)phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsgom// na mo gu ru zhes bya nas bzung ste// gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus bar dmigs pa yin// de nas snang zhing stong la zhes pa nas// thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs shig bya ba'i byar// sku gsung thugs la rtse gcig gsol btab pas// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer ni/

kha dog sna tshogs nam mkha' khyab par 'phros// stong gsum 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya ni// karma pa nyid bye ba phrag brgya sogs// zhing khams thams cad sprul pas khyab rnams dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyi thugs rje bskul// thams cad karma pa yi skur gyur te// dge slong cha lugs zhwa nag gser mdangs can// phyag zhabs bzhi po byin rlobs phyag rgya mdzad// 'ja' 'od me tog char dang spos drir bcas// nam mkha' bar snang gang bar byon nas kyang*// thams cad spyi bo'i karma pa la thim// de ltar bsgom zhing gu ru rat+na nas// zhi bar mdzod par dbyangs dang bcas pas 'don// 'di rnams spyan 'dren byin 'bebs gnyis ka yin// 'di ltar dngos su byon pas si tu pa'i// zhal gzigs thang ka yang ni bri srol byung*// de nas nam mkha' bar snang gang ba yi// mkha' 'gro thams cad gcig la gcig thim nas/ kha dog lnga dang nag mo khra mo bdun// spyi bo'i karma pa la bskor nas bzhugs// las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang mo las// 'od zer ljang gu bdag dang bsrung bya la// phog pas phrag dog las gyur nad gdon grib// thams cad ba mor nyi zer phog ltar bsal// tshe rabs thog ma med nas da lta yan// phrag dog las gyur sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i drung du bshags (288)par bsgom// de bzhin rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo las// 'od zer gser mdog 'phros pas nga rgyal las// gyur pa'i nad gdon grib sogs bsal ba dang*// de'i drung du nga rgyal sdig sgrib bshags// pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo'i 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur nad gdon grib sogs bsal// nad gdon sdig sgrib de'i drung du bshags// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo'i 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur nad gdon grib rnams bsal// de yis drung du gti mug nyes kun bshags// dam tshig mkha' 'gro nag mo'i 'od zer ni// mthing nag 'phros pas dam tshig chags nyams bsal// nag mo 'di ni dpal ldan lha mor gcig

/de yi drung du dam tshig nyams chags bshags// rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo'i 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur nad gdon grib sogs bsal// de'i drung du zhe sdang sdig sgrib bshags// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sku mdog khra mo las// 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros pa yis// dus gsum cha mnyam sgo nas bsags pa yi// nad gdon grib sogs ma lus thams cad bsal// 'gal 'khrul nyes ltung thams cad de la bshags// 'di ni sgrib sbyong mchog tu gyur pa ste// spros med dmigs pa'i mkha' 'gro grib sel yin// 'di nyid 'di ru dgos don ci zhe na// chags nyams sdig sgrib ldan pa'i mi de la// bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par dka' ba ste// byin rlabs ma zhugs nyams rtogs skye mi srid// de phyir thog mar sdig sgrib sbyong phyir yin// nad pa sogs la grib sel byed na yang*// dpal 'bar gtsang ma mtho tshad bdun byas la// dge 'dun pa rnams zhwa khra chos gos byas// bla mas phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gcig gis// phyag rgyas dpal 'bar nad pa'i steng du bzung*// de (289)nyid gong ltar mkha' 'gro mar bsgom ste// de yi 'od kyis nad gdon grib bsal bsgom// mkha' 'gro re re'i sho lo ka re la// me ru zad la khad bar wor la 'don// me ru zad nas de nyid phyir la dor// de 'dra dpal 'bar bdun po rim bzhin bya// gong 'og thun bzhi'i gzhung bzhin tshang ma 'don// mjug tu bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor// 'di yi lugs kyi mkha' 'gro grib sel gyi// phyag len yin zhes slob dpon rnams kyis gsungs// de ni zhor byung tsam gyis bshad pa yin// dngos gzhi mkha' 'gro gsol 'debs tshar ba'i mjug /mkha' 'gro bdun po mkha' 'gro dmar mor thim// de nyid 'od zhu rang la thim pa yi// rang lus tha mal lus 'di gnas 'gyur nas// rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo la// gcer bu dbu skra sil mas sku rgyab non// rgyan cha gzhan med me tog dmar pos brgyan// gri gug bdud rtsis gang ba'i bhan+dha thogs// phag zhag med cing spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs/

kha ṭ+wāṃ med cing g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis// 'od phung dkyil du pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs// de nas spyi gtsug bzhugs pa'i karma pa// mdun du byon nas bde mchog skur gyur te// sku mdog sngon po spyan gsum khro zhing mdzum// dbu skra thor tshugs zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan// stag lpags sham thabs glang chen ko rlon gsol// rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing me phung 'bar// phyag gnyis chos 'byung phyag rgya spyi bor mdzad// zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas gar stabs mdzad// de la rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i phyag g.yon gyis// bdud rtsi drangs pas ye shes me rab 'bar// de nas rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i 'od zer gyis// de nyid bha ga'i nang nas spyan drangs te// rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar pad nyir bzhugs// (290)skabs 'dir rang nyid gcig pu yin na ni// bum can rlung ni drag tu gang bar bya// gcig pu min na bar rlung bzung bas 'thus// de nas snying ga'i he ru ka de yi// dpral bar oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon lte bar hoḥser po// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs dang ni// ye shes bzhi yi ngo bo yin par bsgom// nam mkha' gang nas oṃ zhes bya ba'i bar// tshig 'bru bzhi de lan gsum gyer bar bya// de nas snying gi sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i// he ru ka dpal karma pa de la// bzod blagaglags med pa'i dad gus rtse gcig pas// rje btsun dam pa zhes pa nas bzung ste// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du tshar gcig 'don// karma pa mkhyen de la bsnyen pa bya// snying nas byin gyis rlobs shig zer skabs der// snying ga'i karma pa de 'od du zhu// karma pa yi sku gsung thugs dang ni// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med 'dres// rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma yang 'od du zhu// de yang nam mkhar 'ja' tshon yal bzhin la// ci yang mi dmigs phyag chen nyams len ngang*// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes pa nas// mi 'bral shog ces bar du brjod pa yis// 'khor gsum yongs dag dmigs med bsngo ba yi// mos gus gsol 'debs byin rlabs la brten nas// 'phral du gang shar ngo bo skyong de la// gegs dang grol sa gcig kyang mi 'byung ba// mos gus phyag chen gsang sngags nye lam yin// skye ba kun tu dpal ldan karma pa// zhes sogs smon lam 'di la 'jug sgo gnyis// gal te mi nas mi ru skyes na ni// sangs rgyas stong gis bstan pa ma rdzogs par// karma pa yi sprul pa mi rdzogs pas// de dag bla mar bstan pa'i smon lam yin// gal te bde ba can du skye 'dod na// karma pa dngos 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// 'od dpag med pa'i nye gnas tshul du bzhugs// de nyid bla mar bsten pa'i smon lam yin// de don 'brel pa thogs chog 'jug na gsal// thun bzhi (291)'di ni bla sgrub mchog yin te// rdzogs rim bskal ba du ma'i bar dag tu// 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng spangs nas sgom pa dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor bye ba sgom pa las// bla ma lan gcig sgom pa lhag pa dang*// yi dam bsnyen sgrub sa ya byas pa bas// bla ma'i gsol 'debs gcig ni lhag pa'i tshul// gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa'i phyir// yang zur grwa gsum sgom grwa la sogs su// nyin gsum mtshan gsum 'di la thun bzung ste// gsol 'debs tshigs bcad la sogs 'don srol yod// srod dang tho rangs nam phyed len gsum du// 'khar rnga btang rjes chos khrims pa de yis// sgar pa bskor zhing cog pu thams cad nyug

/ma bton gnyid ni bsdad na chad pa yod// kaṃ tshang nyams len rtsa ba 'di rang yin// 'di ltar gsol ba 'debs par byed pa'i yul// gsol ba khyi btab phag btab sangs mi rgya// bla ma min pa bla mar ma bcos pa// bla ma yin par bla mar byon pa yi// sangs rgyas mnyan pa 'dra zhig dgos zhes gsungs// de don shākya thub pas lung bstan cing*// u rgyan pad+mas mtshan rnams btags pa yi// dwags po dus gsum mkhyen pa nas bzung ste// chos dbyings rdo rje ye shes rdo rje dang*// byang chub rdo rje bdud 'dul rdo rje ste// bcu gsum 'di dag spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos// de dag nor 'khrul 'ong ba'i skabs med de// gong mas rgyab ma gang 'khrungs bka' shog bzhag /mchog gi sprul sku tsā ri mtsho dkar du// sku mtshams mdzad cing thugs dam brtag pa srol// de tshe yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gsal// de phyir brgyud pa 'di ru zhugs phyi nas// dam chos tshul bzhin nyams su ma lon kyang*// bla ma'i phyogs su mgo bo bstan byas te// nyal nas bsdod kyang don chen 'grub bo gsungs// zhes pa grwa slob rnams la phan pa'i phyir// rā ga a s+yas tshig nyung don 'dus smras// bshes gnyen mthar phyin zhes byas yi ger bkod// 'di la 'gal 'khrul nyes pa gang mchis bshags// dge bas 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg rnams// mos gus phyag chen ye shes 'bar bar shog /(292)
